name: Toxic / head

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Head exploding like a ripe pumpkin: deep wet pop, crunchy rupture, broad pulp splatter and dripping.  Element: A sticky soft fibrous rupture and muffled poisonous spore puff, followed by sustained dry papery spore flutter and hollow dusty settling. No liquid Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
